notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine legendary enchantments.
description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar nine times by sacrificing nine Spirits, adding {2}{W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Hei Bai.
Repeat.
